items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: me and my wife, we practically raised Mercer... my being like a father to him

ctx.x: I was going to ask you, now you know -- do you recall how Ellington got that scar he had on his face? Like in Mercer's book --
Well, Ellington had three or four stories. He had one in the book.
